body:
**Add many weapon original & unique**
I created the weapon I want to make and the ideas of my friends.

I am using Google Translate so it may not be accurate.

**Add 16 weapon
These weapons are currently not available in Survival.
Designed for pvp, please try pvp.**

**To activate the skills of this mod, you must use the basic keybind, which is initially set to G.**

<details>
<summary>Weapon overview</summary>

- **Ocean anchor
  This weapon can throw a blade of water and slow down the opponent.**

- **Buster sword
  This weapon can be charged to restrain the opponent with magical power.**

- **The Other Potentiality
  This weapon allows you to toy with your opponent with tricky teleportation.**

- **Spear/gun
  You can launch a surprise attack using the mobility of bullets.**

- **Sword/gun
  This weapon uses bullets to lower the opponent's defense power.**

- **Defensed Factory
  This weapon allows you to use gear to build buildings and perform tower defense.**

- **Bone dagger
  This weapon allows you to deliver a fatal blow when your opponent is off guard and aim to turn things around.**

- **Pizza! Pizza!**

- **Soul eater
  This weapon is a simple weapon that can use buffs when HP is high and recovery when low.
But when used just before death...**

- **Hat Trick
  A tricky weapon that can be used to escape or pursue.**

- **How to use your eyes
  Also known as Metavision This weapon can be used by using a specific key and lowers the defense power of surrounding enemies.**

- **SCAR
  This weapon can be fired using bullets, and when it hits, it can inflict a debuff on the opponent, and the debuff can be activated by reloading.**

- **Twin type
  This weapon consists of a confession and a red eye, allowing you to adjust the distance between you and your opponent.**
  
- **Ghost's taste
  This weapon is a combination of a blackjack and a gun.**

- **Follow your instincts 
  Also known as Predator Eye, can temporarily strengthen your body.**

- **Rain
  This weapon can drop lightning by firing upwards.**

- **Death Star
  This weapon will cause a deadly explosion in your location after a certain amount of time.**

</details>
